findings.description: The deleted `_read_file_bytes` helper restored the file position after reading. The replacement calls `value.read()` directly and leaves the position at EOF. The parsed form is cached and shared, so the same UploadFile can be read more than once. This happens when several dependencies or the endpoint declare `File()` or `Form()` params for the same field, or when one field is typed as both `bytes` and `UploadFile`. Any later read, including the endpoint's own `await file.read()`, then returns `b''`, which gives empty or truncated content. The same problem applies to the list-of-bytes branch.
findings.suggestion: Keep the helper that saves the position with `tell()`, reads, and then seeks back in a `finally` block. Use it at both call sites.
findings.title: Removed file position restore makes bytes reads consume the UploadFile
